question: Which aspects of Rāma are invoked to protect the tongue and throat?
premises: The treasury of knowledge is asked to protect the tongue
The one honored by Bharata is asked to protect the throat
inference: Specific aspects of Rāma are invoked to guard the organs of speech.
uncertainties: vidyānidhiṃ taken as epithet of Rāma functioning as subject
plain_english: May the treasury of knowledge protect the tongue; may the one honored by Bharata protect the throat.
